parameter.name: whitelistTagIds
parameter.label: Authorized Tag IDs
parameter.description: idTag whitelist. Empty accepts every tag; otherwise unknown tags are rejected.

parameter.name: autoLearn
parameter.label: Auto-learn Cards
parameter.description: When on, a tapped tag that is not yet authorized is added to the list above. Turn it on while enrolling cards, then off again.

parameter.name: discoverCards
parameter.label: Discover New Cards
parameter.description: When on, a tapped tag that no user owns is offered in the inbox to create a user from. Turn it on while adding people, then off again.
